facts.fact: The Bank of Sierra Leone regulates the financial activities of mobile money operators on the basis of the licence it gives them, under the National Payment Systems Act 2022, per NatCA's presentation.
facts.system: Bank of Sierra Leone mobile money licensing

facts.fact: NatCA presented a proposed digital financial services quality-of-service framework with consumer protection provisions on complaint timeframes and proposed fines, jointly with the Bank of Sierra Leone.

SLE.note: Framework and sanctions are described as proposed.

facts.fact: NatCA states the Bank of Sierra Leone regulates mobile money operators under Section 2 of the National Payment Systems Act 2022, alongside a Draft Non-Bank Led Mobile Money Regulation of 2024.

SLE.note: Draft Non-Bank Led Mobile Money Regulation 2024 noted as draft; non-bank licensing not stated.

facts.fact: NatCA says it monitors mobile network operators and their affiliated mobile money operators in Sierra Leone, and inter-operator transactions are not yet activated.
